labels.caption: Caption
labels.heading: Heading
labels.logo_social: Brand logo for sharing and gift cards
labels.show_credit: Show "Theme by ZeronKit" credit in the footer
labels.sticky_info: Keep product details in view while scrolling
labels.transparent_home: Transparent over the first section on the home page
labels.transparent_text: Text and icon colour when transparent
labels.suggested_collection: Suggested collection when nothing is found
labels.colour_gallery: Show only the selected colour's images
labels.show_per_page: Let shoppers choose how many products to show
labels.show_arrows_rail: Show arrows on the scrolling row
labels.show_signature: Show the store name in large type

labels.show_product_list: Show the product list next to the image

info.announcement: Keep it short: two or three messages work best.
info.arabic_fonts: Most library fonts do not include Arabic letters. Arabic text automatically uses a matching system font.
info.card_sizes: Lists the values of the size option and strikes through the ones that are out of stock.
info.colour_bar: Turns the colour filter into a row of swatch links above the grid. Needs a colour filter in the Search and Discovery app.
info.complementary: Products are set in the Search and Discovery app.
info.contrast: Keep text and background contrast at 4.5:1 or higher so everyone can read your store.
info.credit: The "Theme by ZeronKit" credit can be switched off in Theme settings, Theme credit.
info.credit_setting: A small thank you link to the free theme's maker. Switch it off any time.
info.custom_liquid: Add app snippets or other Liquid code.
info.dynamic_checkout: Shows payment buttons such as Shop Pay. Set them up in your payment settings.
info.favicon: Shown in browser tabs. Use a square image of 32 x 32 px.
info.featured_media: Images, videos and 3D models of the chosen product.
info.filters: Set up filters in the Search and Discovery app.
info.follow_on_shop: Needs Shop Pay to be turned on.
info.gradient: Optional. Replaces the solid background where supported.
info.load_first: Turn on when this is the first section on the page, so the image loads quickly.
info.logo_social: Used in search results, social sharing and on the gift card page.
info.nested_menu: Supports three levels. Second level items become column headings, third level items are listed below them.
info.new_badge: Days since a product was published. Set to 0 to hide the badge.
info.newsletter: Sign-ups are added to your customer list with the newsletter tag.
info.rail_menu: Optional row of pill links under the header, for example Women, Men, Kids, Sport.
info.related: Recommendations are made automatically. Adjust them in the Search and Discovery app.
info.social: Add your links in Theme settings, Social media.
info.swatches: Colour swatches use the colours and images set on your product option values.
info.image_collection: Used when no image is chosen. Shows the collection image, or its first product image.
info.tab_source: Materials uses the shanasheel.materials, custom.material and shanasheel.care metafields, then the Materials and Care sections of the description. Shipping uses the Shipping or Delivery section and links your shipping and refund policies.
info.tab_content: Your own text for this tab. When the product has no content of its own, this text is shown, and if it is empty a built-in default is used.
info.contact_form: Messages are sent with Shopify to your store sender email. Spam protection is handled by Shopify.
info.email_required: Email is always required, so Shopify can send the message. If you remove this block, an email field is still shown first.
info.info_menu: For example links to your FAQ, shipping and returns pages.
info.navigator: The navigator opens your menu as an index with image tiles. On phones it is always the menu.
info.hide_first_item: A first menu item that only repeats the navigator, such as Shop, is hidden automatically.
info.transparent_home: The header turns solid as soon as the shopper scrolls.
info.announcement_speed: For the fade and marquee modes. Moving messages always have a pause button and stay still for shoppers who prefer reduced motion.
info.dismissible: Closed bars stay hidden until the browser tab is closed.
info.schemes: Six schemes come ready: 1 Paper, 2 Ink, 3 Sand, 4 Sage, 5 Blush, 6 High contrast. Style presets change all of them at once.
info.policies: Lists every policy you have filled in under Settings, Policies.
info.footer_menu: If this menu is empty, the footer menu is used, then your common pages and blog.
info.style_intro: Ready-made choices for the whole store. Pick one, then fine-tune colours, fonts and corners further down if you like.
info.palette: Replaces colour schemes 1 and 3. Choose Custom to edit every scheme yourself.
info.font_pairing: The ready pairs use fonts already on the shopper's device, so nothing extra downloads. The Arabic pair reads well in Arabic. Custom uses the font pickers in Typography.
info.animations: Reveal on scroll, image zoom and drawer motion. Shoppers who ask their device for reduced motion never see movement.
info.corner_radius: Used when Style > Corners is set to Custom.
info.search_popular: Separate searches with commas. Shown on the search page, in the search overlay and when nothing is found.
info.suggested_collection: Leave empty to show your newest products.
info.search_popular_where: Popular searches are set in Theme settings > Search.
info.logo_position: For the inline, centred and minimal layouts. The split, editorial and side layouts always centre the logo.
info.text_logo: Shown when no logo image is chosen. Leave empty to use the store name.
info.colour_gallery: Images are matched by alt text ending in "in [colour]", for example "Lounge chair in oak". Without that, each colour variant's image starts its group. Products without colour data show all images.
info.show_per_page: Shows a 12, 24, 36 or 48 per page choice. The choice is remembered in a hidden cart attribute.
info.hotspot_position: Measured on the photo. Pins without a product show store products in order.
info.dimensions_image: Uses the product image when empty.
info.value_cm: Inches are calculated for the switch.
info.band_heading: Shown above blocks placed in the details band under the gallery.
info.finishes: Shows the values of the first product option with one of the names below. Images and notes come from the shanasheel.finishes metafield (a list of metaobjects with name, image, color and note fields), matched by name. Without a matching option, the metafield entries are shown on their own. Clicking a finish selects it when the variant picker shows that option as buttons.
info.delivery: Uses the shanasheel.lead_time metafield (variant first, then product) when it is set. Otherwise the estimate uses these day ranges: in stock, or out of stock but still for sale (made to order).
info.dimensions: Reads the metafields shanasheel.width, shanasheel.depth, shanasheel.height, shanasheel.seat_height, shanasheel.diameter, shanasheel.length and shanasheel.weight (dimension, weight or text), shanasheel.dimensions (one "Label: value" per line), shanasheel.materials and shanasheel.finish. A Dimensions or Materials heading in the description is shown too and removed from the main description.
info.dimension_rows: One row per line, for example "Width: 210 cm". Used when the product has no shanasheel.dimensions metafield.
info.guide_page: Opens in a side drawer. Defaults to a page with the handle measuring-guide.
info.care_assembly: Reads the metafields shanasheel.care, shanasheel.assembly, shanasheel.assembly_level (ready, easy or required) and shanasheel.assembly_guide (file or url), then Care and Assembly headings in the description. The settings below are used when those are empty.
info.shop_the_room: Image: this block, then the shanasheel.room_image metafield, then the product's second image. Products: the ones chosen here, then the shanasheel.room_products metafield (a list of products), then this product. Positions are measured from the top left corner of the image.
info.related_fallback: Shown while recommendations load and when Shopify has none yet. Defaults to the product's first collection.
info.banner_style: Full image uses the collection image, or the first product image when the collection has none.
info.rooms_menu: Leave empty to list collections that have products.
info.empty_collection: Leave empty to show the newest products.
info.showroom_image: A photo of your showroom or a styled room.

options.card_plinth: Plinth (soft base, price beside the name)
